item.title: Blit 0.2.21
item.description: Two panes by default, as in ForkLift: F5 copies and F6 moves the selection to the other pane (also in the right-click menu), ⌘U swaps them, and each pane remembers its folder. View › Columns shows or hides Date Modified, Size, Status and Kind. Dragging files to Finder, the Desktop or another app now hands over the file itself.
